It takes twenty minutes to get to the riverside walk by bike. They took many photos at the city square. Eva wrote about the day in the diary. The self-checkout asked for ID.
The riverside walk is one of the best places in the city. The weather was windy that day. Eva borrowed a book about history from the zoo. The sign said buy one get one free.
Eva and Lily had great fun there. Lily is interested in singing. Eva bought a T-shirt at the shop yesterday. Grandma cooked eggplant with garlic for tonight's dinner.
Both of them like soup and milk. Eva drinks milk after doing sports. Eva hopes to visit Toronto one day.
